testcase.name: Scenario: Launch a choice from a grouped command menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:423:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Launch a choice from a grouped command menu ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model Work Features panel contains a grouped "Plane" command ✔ When the user opens the Plane drop-down and selects "Offset from Plane" ✔ Then the menu closes ✔ And the software prompts the user to select a planar face ✔ When the user presses Escape without selecting a face ✔ Then the software returns to the ready state ✔ And the grouped Plane control and the part remain visible ✔ And no new work plane is created
